newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS confirms Molson Cos, outlook stable.
newsitem.headline: CBRS confirms Molson Cos, outlook stable.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Monday that it reaffirmed the debt ratings of Molson Cos and maintained the company's ratings outlook at stable.
CBRS said Molson's senior unsecured debt rating is A and its commercial paper is rated A-1+.
The company had been on the rating agency's credit watch list since January, following the announcement of the sale of the majority of Diversey Corp, its specialty chemical operation, to Unilever NV.

The April disposal and related book loss of Diversey has reduced Molson's equity base, but has also enabled significant debt reduction. Numerous write-offs undertaken in all of the company's operating segments affected fiscal 1996 results, but improved cash flow and earnings in 1997 appear imminent, CBRS said.
